sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare and Energy dominate leadership with sustained cross-timeframe strength, while Consumer Defensive shows early signs of fading despite an all-green profile.

Leadership remains narrow with only 3 of 11 sectors posting all-green performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons. Healthcare (0.883 momentum) and Energy (0.850 momentum) represent the core engines of the market, holding top-three ranks consistently over the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows. 

Rotation beneath the surface is subdued, though defensive positioning is splintering. While Healthcare gained +1 spot over the last 5 sessions to reach rank 3, Consumer Defensive slipped 1 spot to rank 4 despite its high 0.650 momentum. Meanwhile, bottom-tier groups remain stagnant, with Utilities (0.167) and Communication Services (0.217) lagging broad market momentum.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 3 of 11 sectors—Healthcare (0.883 momentum), Energy (0.850), and Consumer Defensive (0.650)—are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD.
- **Sustained leadership:** Healthcare and Energy are the sole sectors maintaining top-3 standing across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks.
- **Top momentum clusters:** Healthcare (0.883, YTD rank 3) and Energy (0.850, YTD rank 1) lead all sectors, followed by Consumer Defensive (0.650) and Technology (0.633, YTD rank 2).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Five-day rank gainers:** Healthcare improved +1 spot to rank 3 (momentum 0.883), and Real Estate edged up +1 spot to rank 8 despite weak 0.267 momentum.
- **Five-day rank decliners:** Communication Services fell -1 spot to rank 9 (0.217 momentum), and Consumer Defensive dropped -1 spot to rank 4.
- **Momentum laggards:** Utilities sits at the bottom of the market with a 0.167 momentum score (YTD rank 10), joined by Communication Services (0.217) and Real Estate (0.267).

## Divergences
- **Consumer Defensive slipping:** Consumer Defensive flags as an early-warning fade, shedding 1 rank spot over the last 5 sessions despite holding an otherwise strong 0.650 momentum score and all-green status.
- **Real Estate low-momentum advance:** Real Estate gained +1 rank spot over 5 sessions, yet its absolute momentum remains depressed at 0.267 (YTD rank 8).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Travel, healthcare, and energy dominate sustained leadership while industrials and basic materials suffer sharp short-term rank drops.

Market breadth remains selective, with 28 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all timeframes. High-conviction strength is concentrated in hospitality and healthcare, led by REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.921) and Health Information Services (momentum 0.883). Energy subsectors—including Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.86) and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.84)—also maintain sustained multi-month leadership alongside steady retail pockets like Department Stores.

Rotational flows show strong bids in Lodging (+17 spots) and Insurance Brokers (+17 spots), contrasting with sharp pullbacks across cyclical and industrial groups. Engineering & Construction plunged 23 spots to rank 61, while Coking Coal slipped 21 spots to rank 119. Concurrently, housing-related pockets are flashing early turnaround signals, while higher-momentum segments like Software - Infrastructure and Tobacco are beginning to lose rank.

## Strength
- **Hospitality & Travel:** REIT - Hotel & Motel sits as the top overall momentum leader (0.921, rank 7), supported by Lodging, which holds an all-green profile and 0.882 momentum.
- **Healthcare & Diagnostics:** Health Information Services (momentum 0.883, rank 17) and Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.860, rank 31) maintain all-green profiles and sustained top-36 rankings over 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Energy & Insurance:** Sustained strength persists across Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.86), Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.84), Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, and Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.867).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Insurance Brokers led advances (+17 spots to rank 103, momentum 0.62), matched by Lodging (+17 spots to rank 29), with Silver adding 14 spots (rank 46, momentum 0.59) and Biotechnology gaining 11 spots (rank 43, momentum 0.67).
- **Steepest Drops:** Engineering & Construction fell 23 spots (rank 61, momentum 0.23), Coking Coal dropped 21 spots (rank 119, momentum 0.23), and Internet Content & Information lost 18 spots (rank 75, momentum 0.46).
- **Bottom Laggards:** REIT - Mortgage (0.069, rank 137), Solar (0.086, rank 139), and Advertising Agencies (0.108, rank 144) remain the weakest momentum groups in the market.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Software - Infrastructure (momentum 0.63, rank -7), Shell Companies (momentum 0.71, rank -6), Tobacco (momentum 0.64, rank -6), and Medical Care Facilities (momentum 0.61, rank -5) are seeing short-term relative rank deterioration despite elevated momentum scores.
- **Emerging Construction & Housing Signals:** Several building-linked industries are advancing in rank despite lagging baseline momentum, including Building Materials (+5 spots, momentum 0.33), Residential Construction (+5 spots, momentum 0.29), and Lumber & Wood Production (+5 spots, momentum 0.47).
- **Transport & Retail Early Turnarounds:** Integrated Freight & Logistics (+5 spots, momentum 0.47) and Home Improvement Retail (+4 spots, momentum 0.42) are also exhibiting early-stage rank improvement from lower momentum bases.
